name: International Business Machines Corporation
reason: Revenue CAGR -1.9% over 10y and adjusted EPS still 0.81x its 2015 level, adjusted-vs-GAAP gap ~103% and acquisitions 52% of FCF, with AI disintermediation risk to consulting; FCF yield 7.2% does not make it special.

name: Installed Building Products, Inc.
reason: Residential new-construction insulation installer with EPS at 1.0x its 10y max and margins near a 10y high (13.1% vs 9.8% avg) after a housing up-cycle; growth partly roll-up (acquisitions 61% of FCF) and FY1 EPS guided -9.5%.

name: ICU Medical, Inc.
reason: Growth bought, not built: acquisitions 3.4x 10y FCF (Smiths Medical), shares +4.2%/yr, EBIT margin collapsed from 26% to 4.8%, 10y ROIC 3.3% and net debt/EBITDA 3.2x.

name: Incyte Corporation
reason: Earnings hinge on Jakafi, which faces loss of exclusivity around 2028 (a drug patent cliff inside 5 years); EPS history highly erratic (2024 $1.08 vs 2025 $6.80) and FY1 consensus -53%.

name: Invitation Homes, Inc.
reason: Single-family rental REIT with net debt/EBITDA 5.3x, shares compounding +7%/yr, FFO/share growth only ~6%/yr and live regulatory risk to institutional home ownership; no specialness beyond scale.

name: Innovex International, Inc.
reason: Oilfield equipment supplier whose earnings follow upstream capex and oil prices; EPS 0.24x 10y max, 10y average ROIC about zero, merger-driven share count.

name: Innospec Incorporated
reason: Ordinary specialty chemicals with oilfield and fuel exposure: 10y EPS CAGR 1.9%, margin flat at ~9-10% and 10y ROIC 8.5%; clean balance sheet but nothing special.

name: Iridium Communications Inc.
reason: Credible technology threat from Starlink/direct-to-device satellite competitors within 5 years, net debt/EBITDA 3.8x and EPS 0.58x its 10y max on a 34x NTM P/E; FCF route only.

name: Iron Mountain Incorporated
reason: Sticky records-storage franchise but net debt/EBITDA 7.8x and negative 10y FCF conversion (-0.25) as growth now depends on debt-funded data-center build-out; shares +3.5%/yr.

name: Jacobs Solutions Inc.
reason: Steady EPS compounding (8.6% 10y CAGR, margins up to 7.6%) but portfolio repeatedly reshaped (CH2M, Amentum spin, PA Consulting) with acquisitions ~0.98x FCF and flat revenue, so the core organic run-rate is hard to pin down.

name: Kirby Corporation
reason: Inland tank-barge earnings are cyclical with petrochemical volumes and rates: EPS at 1.0x 10y max and margin in 91st percentile after a 5-year run-up from $0.56 in 2021.

name: Kodiak Gas Services, Inc.
reason: Contract compression tied to Permian oil and gas activity, net debt/EBITDA 3.8x, negative FCF yield (-5.1%) and EPS 0.37x its 2021 peak.

name: Knife River Corporation
reason: Aggregates is a good local-oligopoly business, but this 2023 spin has grown via acquisitions (2.5x FCF, Strata), FCF conversion 0.44 and EPS fell 22% in 2025, leaving too short a clean record to forecast.

name: Kinsale Capital Group, Inc.
reason: Disciplined, low-cost E&S underwriter with founder-CEO, 10y ROIC ~20%, EPS grown from $1.24 to $19.51 (2016-25) with no acquisitions or dilution; watch for E&S softening as EPS sits at a peak.

name: Knight-Swift Transportation Holdings Inc.
reason: Truckload earnings set by the freight cycle: EPS 0.25x 10y max, margin 3.3% vs 17% peak, shares +7%/yr from deals; the recovery bet is cyclical, not special.

name: Kilroy Realty Corporation
reason: West Coast office REIT facing structural office-demand decline (tech/remote work) with net debt/EBITDA 6.8x and FFO/share CAGR 2.2% over 10y.

name: Kimbell Royalty Partners LP
reason: Oil and gas mineral royalties: earnings set by commodity prices, growth bought through acquisitions (1.2x FCF) and unit issuance, negative 10y ROIC.

name: Kenvue, Inc.
reason: Tylenol autism litigation and a pending Kimberly-Clark takeover cloud the outlook; GAAP EPS 0.76 vs 1.10 in 2022 with flat margins despite strong brands.

name: Klaviyo, Inc.
reason: Fast-growing e-commerce marketing SaaS but GAAP losses every year (EBIT margin -5.1%), heavy Shopify ecosystem dependence and AI-driven competition make 5-10y earnings unforecastable.

name: Quaker Houghton
reason: Industrial fluids tied to steel, auto and metalworking cycles; 10y EPS CAGR 4.7% with acquisitions 1.35x FCF, shares +2.8%/yr and 10y ROIC 5%.
